nilpotent_lift.scope: Finite nilpotent ring complexes and recurrence; no labelled Floer construction.

lattice_units.scope: Finite congruence recurrence and a torsion-containing chain example; no instanton maps.

saturated_residue.scope: Augmented finite subspace-poset identities, with an unsaturated failure control.

product_shuffle.scope: Exact signed staircase shuffles, including empty flags and augmented boundaries.

groupoid_weights.scope: Finite groupoid homotopy masses and pushforward composition; no spectral character splitting.

lattice_counts.scope: Finite subgroup-basis enumeration and exact p-adic precision checks; no profinite kernel theorem.

Cartier_halving.scope: Exact polynomial Cartier identities and threshold arithmetic; no full Steenrod tensor obstruction.

primitive_roots.scope: Exact coproduct kernels in a non-primitively generated polynomial Hopf algebra; no spherical-class classification.

limitations: Finite algebra does not certify cosmetic surgery, Quillen rational homology, chromatic fixed-point loss or Curtis claims.
